## [v0.1.3](https://github.com/serhii-kucherenko/loupe/releases/tag/v0.1.3) - 2026-08-30

**0.1.3 - the picture is right**

**Take this one.** Before it, annotating inside a presented screen - a sheet, a full-screen cover, a reader - photographed the screen *underneath* it. That is worse than no picture, because nothing about it says it is wrong, and whoever reads the ticket has no way to know.

### Fixed

- **Annotating inside a presented screen captured the wrong screen** (SER-718). The render draws the window rather than the root view controller's view, because UIKit puts a presented controller in its own container beside it. Web content inside a native app now comes through as real pixels too: `WKWebView` renders out of process, so it is asked for a snapshot rather than drawn.
- **The tag you pick never reached the issue** (SER-719). `issueCreate` takes `labelIds`, not names. It now matches your workspace's labels, ignoring case, and never creates one. No match is written into the issue body as a sentence, so a choice is never quietly lost.
- **A refused send now says why** - the body Linear actually returned, which host refused it, and which of the three calls it was. A scope refusal is recognised whatever status code carries it.
- **Leaving annotate mode** took two taps in two places, and the first was not obvious (SER-721, SER-723).

### New

- **The overlay can wear your design system** (SER-724). Both SDKs:

  ```swift
  Loupe.start(app: app, theme: LoupeTheme.Appearance(accent: indigo, panelRadius: 28))
  ```
  ```ts
  start({ app, theme: { accent: "var(--brand)", panelRadius: 28 } })
  ```

  Every field has a default, so you name only what you have an opinion about, and the wash inside a picked element follows your accent without being asked. Omit it and nothing changes.

- **The whole flow is on the pull**: Send, close, and the drawer, with nothing hidden. Saving a note leaves you ready to pick the next one.
- **`Loupe.stop()`** tears the overlay down and hands the keyboard back, for a host that turns Loupe off from its own menu.

### One source-breaking change

`Loupe.capture(at:in:comment:)` is `async`. It only affects a host driving Loupe directly rather than through the overlay. A `WKWebView` renders out of process and the only way to get its real pixels is to ask WebKit and wait; the alternative was a picture of the previous screen. Add `await`.

### Under it

244 Swift tests, 55 web tests, 13 iPad UI cases driven with a real finger, Swift 6 clean. Two lints run in CI: one fails the build on a new way for something to fail without saying so, one on a colour, font or radius written outside the theme.

**Full changelog**: https://github.com/serhii-kucherenko/loupe/compare/v0.1.2...v0.1.3
